target_customer: Aircraft engine makers and light aviation OEMs first, then data center operators needing off grid power and cooling water
problem: Steam injection raises turbine efficiency and cuts NOx but needs water that aircraft cannot carry. Viraj recovers water from exhaust. The same loop supplies power and cooling water to data centers without a grid or water pipeline.
business_model: Engine and genset hardware sales plus development work with engine makers, not fully specified in sources
product_category: Steam injected gas turbines for aviation and onsite power

founders.name: Joseph Risson
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, worked on hybrid-electric propulsion and hydrogen propulsion; glider pilot.

founders.name: Mathilde Bouilloux
education: Ecole des Ponts ParisTech (Institut Polytechnique de Paris)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, led development of six power projects totaling 120+ MW and was an investment analyst.

competitors.name: ProEnergy PE6000
competitors.what: Aeroderivative gas turbine packages sold for data center power
competitors.traction_then: 75 packages built since 2020, Crusoe contract for 13 units announced April 2026

competitors.name: Boom Superpower turbine
competitors.what: 42 MW turbine derived from supersonic engine work, sold for data centers
competitors.traction_then: Crusoe order for 29 units reported at $1.25B, deliveries from 2027

technical_complexity.rationale: Closed loop water recovery and steam injection in a flight engine is research grade. The team must build a turbine, a condenser and certify it, with a first test flight planned for 2027.

defensibility.rationale: Company calls the water recovery system patented. Aircraft engine certification and OEM partnerships raise barriers. Patent claims were not independently verified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Safran is named by the company as a working partner. No incumbent copying or acquisition is reported as of November 2026.

market_need_then: AI data center power demand created long turbine lead times, with Mitsubishi Power quoted around 2031 for new orders per press, and pushed buyers toward aeroderivative units. Aviation also needs fuel and emissions cuts.

identity.visual_style: Dark background presentation with white partner logos
identity.voice_and_tone: Short declarative sustainability messaging such as A new turbine for flight and power

brand_strength.rationale: Few sources discuss the brand itself. Product names Eyja and Gena are distinctive, but the company is early and little brand coverage exists.

pivots.from: Steam injection turbine for light aircraft
pivots.to: Also gas turbine gensets for data centers with water recovery
pivots.why: Company says two thirds of new data centers are in water stressed regions and need power without a grid

outcome_analysis: Viraj Aero raised a EUR 4.5M seed in August 2026 and joined YC in Fall 2026 while building toward a 2027 test flight. The data center power shortage gives it a timing tailwind beyond aviation. The risk is long certification and hardware timelines against larger turbine makers.
notes: Seed amount is EUR 4.5M per the Aerospace Valley press release and Nordic9, converted loosely to USD by TrySignalBase, so amount_usd is left null. Date is 31 August 2026 in the press release and 18 August on Nordic9. Company founding year not found. Company has 15 staff per the press release summary. Name origin not found; no outcome news found. The pivot entry reflects site positioning, not a stated change.
